task.description: TEST-RUNNER (Step 5) FAILed ISS-0100's fix: TC-DB-01-01/TC-DB-01-02 (db_integration_test.zig — the exact original #357 symptom) still fail with 'ISS-503 pre-flight failed: N tenant(s) still in LEGACY_RLS mode'. Root cause (confirmed by ORCH via direct DB inspection immediately after TEST-RUNNER's run completed): 15 rows with tenant_type='production' AND storage_mode='LEGACY_RLS' were present, all traced by slug (tc-adp-04b-*, tc-tm-01-*, tc-tm-03-*, tc-tm-04-*, tc-tm-05-*) to tests/integration/adp04b_tenant_realm_binding_test.zig and tm01/03/04/05_*_test.zig. These files are CORRECTLY using tenant_type='production' (they call the real service.createTenant() production API path to test real tenant-onboarding business logic — NOT a bare fixture INSERT, so they are legitimately out of scope for ISS-0100's original 'normalize fixture inserts to tenant_type=test' fix, and were correctly excluded from the original design's file list). Each of these files DOES have `defer cleanupTenantBySlug(...)` logic that issues an unconditional `DELETE FROM tenant WHERE slug = $1` (verified: adp04b_tenant_realm_binding_test.zig lines 56-67). ORCH re-ran `python tools/clean_test_db.py` immediately after TEST-RUNNER's failing run and confirmed it DOES sweep these leaked rows cleanly (tenant table dropped to 1 row, the SCHEMA-mode default). This means the leak is NOT a missing-cleanup bug in adp04b/tm0x's own test code — their `defer` cleanup works when the test process runs to completion normally. The leak must instead be a WITHIN-INVOCATION timing/ordering issue: db_integration_test.zig, adp04b_tenant_realm_binding_test.zig, and tm01/03/04/05_*_test.zig are all compiled into the SAME aggregate binary (tests/integration/main_test.zig, built once for the shared test-integration_step per build.zig lines ~841/1258) and Zig runs all test{} blocks within one binary sequentially with no cross-test-file cleanup barrier — if db_integration_test.zig's guard-checking test happens to execute in the same process BEFORE adp04b/tm0x's tests reach their own end-of-test `defer cleanup`, or while some adp04b/tm0x test earlier in the run failed an assertion (assertion failures in Zig test blocks DO still run defers, but need to verify this is actually true for this test runner/harness setup, and whether any of the 99 concurrent full-suite failures included an adp04b/tm0x test that could have skipped its own cleanup via a different failure mode e.g. panic vs expect-failure), the guard sees the not-yet-cleaned rows. Your job: (1) Determine precisely why these rows were present at guard-check time — read db_integration_test.zig, adp04b_tenant_realm_binding_test.zig, and tm01/03/04/05_*_test.zig to determine ACTUAL execution order within main_test.zig (Zig test declaration/import order) and confirm whether db_integration_test's guard check can run before adp04b/tm0x's cleanup defers fire, or whether one of the 99 concurrently-failing tests in that run was itself an adp04b/tm0x test that panicked (not just failed an expect) before its defer ran. (2) Determine the correct minimal fix: options include (a) reordering test file imports in main_test.zig so db_integration_test's guard-check runs strictly after all tenant-creating tests' cleanup, (b) making TC-DB-01-01/02 run in their own isolated build step (like test-integration-iss503 already does) so they never share a process with adp04b/tm0x, (c) something else you find more correct after reading the actual test harness code. This is a genuine gap in ISS-0100's original scope (the diagnosis and design never examined adp04b/tm0x since they don't do bare INSERT INTO tenant), not a flaw in the fix already shipped (which TEST-RUNNER confirmed works correctly for its own 13 files). Write your findings and recommendation to docs/issue-reports/ISS-0100-rework1-diagnosis.yaml. Do not implement a fix yourself — route to CODE-DESIGNER next.

result.summary: Root cause pinned down with direct code evidence, not speculation. TC-DB-01-01/TC-DB-01-02 fail not because of test declaration order or a panic-skips-defer bug (both explicitly ruled out), but because tests/integration/helpers.zig's TestHarness.init() calls Migrations.run() unconditionally on EVERY invocation throughout the ~700-test main_test.zig binary's lifetime (not once at startup), re-querying public.schema_migrations fresh each time with no in-process cache. GBL-102's pre-flight guard never records itself as applied while any tenant_type='production' + storage_mode='LEGACY_RLS' row exists, so it is retried and can fail at ANY of the ~15+ TestHarness.init() call sites in the binary -- not just db_integration_test.zig's two tests -- whenever adp04b_tenant_realm_binding_test.zig/tm01/03/04/05's correctly-implemented but necessarily transient service.createTenant() fixture rows are momentarily present mid-suite. Also discovered build.zig's test-integration-env step is not actually a scoped subset (it compiles the identical full main_test.zig suite as a second binary), which is why TEST-RUNNER's 'isolated' rerun still reproduced the failure. Recommendation: no changes needed to adp04b/tm0x's own cleanup (already correct); scope GBL-102's guard to exclude the project's existing tc-* test-fixture slug naming convention (paired with a lint enforcing that convention), plus optional build.zig step-naming cleanup for test-integration-env. Full evidence chain in the diagnosis report.
